Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) operations are conducted according to documented policies, standards, procedures and/or other organizational directives.
resources (e.g., people, processes, technologies, data and/or facilities) identified as necessary to support Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) operations are allocated.
responsibility and authority for the performance of Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR)-related activities are assigned to designated personnel.
personnel performing Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR)-related activities have the skills and knowledge needed to perform their assigned duties.
a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) is established with a documented scope that identifies the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) it covers.
the Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) addresses the resilience of in-scope Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during routine operations.
the Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) addresses the resilience of in-scope Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during adverse conditions.
